Round-trip formatting prevents precision loss on focus exit.

corrected_native_validation.independent_parser_method: Python standard-library struct unpacking of binary STL, f64 cross products for nonzero areas and f64 signed determinant summation with math.fsum. No NODES geometry code is used.
